verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents SharePoint REST and Graph APIs for CRUD on lists, files and settings, plus webhooks for list-change notifications. None of it documents team event or audit logs, an audit-log API, or SIEM export. Change-notification webhooks are an adjacent feature, not an auditable activity log, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, activity is auditable — team event/audit logs with documented API access or SIEM export
